Image 36beacon.sh

Maker

@astrodevilGreat question Anand! The biggest opportunity we’re seeing is eliminating repeated exploration and debugging by letting agents reuse hard-earned context from previous sessions.

On staleness, traces give us a continuous feedback loop. Beacon can see how agents apply what they’ve learned in future sessions, catch patterns that stop working, and update or retire stale knowledge.

Would love your feedback on Beacon! And if you find it useful, an upvote and GitHub star would mean a lot :)
